purpose: Activate only the home-field scope accepted by H3 and H3V: the independently calibrated 2.082-point league domestic home advantage and explicit zero base home advantage for resolved neutral/international-neutral games. Team/stadium deviations remain shadow-only because their year-to-year survival was not sufficient for production authority.

DOMESTIC_LEAGUE_BASELINE.rule: For a governed DOMESTIC_HOME game, replace the provisional 1.5-point location term with the accepted 2.082 league baseline while preserving every non-location component exactly.

NEUTRAL_ZERO_BASE.rule: Resolved neutral and international-neutral games carry zero base HFA. Travel, time zone, weather and other game factors remain separate layers.

TEAM_VENUE_BLANKET.reason: H2 team/venue deviations did not equal or beat league-only HFA on both held-out MAE and RMSE.

SELECTIVE_VENUE_ADJUSTMENTS.reason: H3V survivalCoefficientK was 0.034 and zero venues qualified under the pre-2025 rolling rules.

arithmetic.homeSpreadConvention: Positive HFA benefits the home team, so pointsToHomeSpread is negative.
arithmetic.recomputeFormula: nonLocationExactFairHome = currentGrahamExactFairHome - currentLocationPointsToHomeSpread; newGrahamExactFairHome = nonLocationExactFairHome + governedH4LocationPointsToHomeSpread
arithmetic.precision: Preserve the exact 2.082 location value and exact fair internally; display rounds to the ordinary nearest 0.5 point.
arithmetic.idempotency: A game already marked with this productionId and the exact governed location term is not adjusted a second time.

preservationRules.personnelOverlay: personnelOverlayPointsToHomeSpread must remain numerically unchanged. If personnelBaselineExactFairHome exists, recompute it only as new exact fair minus the unchanged personnel overlay so the stored decomposition remains internally consistent.
preservationRules.otherAdjustments: Every non-HOME_FIELD/non-VENUE adjustment is preserved byte-for-field in the game adjustment list.
preservationRules.playerValues: Never change the Madden/Walters player-value registry.
preservationRules.personnelLedger: Never change the active personnel ledger during H4 home-field activation.
preservationRules.gameFactors: Rest, travel, time-zone, altitude, weather, surface, crowd/noise and other S/W-factor mechanisms receive no new numeric authority from H4.
preservationRules.market: Pinnacle, Bet365, DraftKings and all market prices remain forbidden H4 inputs.
